teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: bill, check, pay, card, cash, receipt, supermarket, market, kilo, bottle, piece, tip

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
bill, check, pay, card, cash, receipt, supermarket, market, kilo, bottle, piece, tip
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• The bill, please (requesting restaurant bill)
• Can I pay by card or in cash? (asking payment method)
• I would like one kilo of potatoes (specifying quantity)
• Here is your receipt and change (cashier response)
Pronunciation Focus:
Pronunciation of 'receipt' /rɪˈsiːt/ (silent 'p').

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Payment Questions & Quantity Expressions ('How much is the bill?', 'Can I pay by card?', 'a kilo of apples')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Payment Questions & Quantity Expressions ('How much is the bill?', 'Can I pay by card?', 'a kilo of apples')
Controlled Practice:
You finished dinner at a restaurant and want to pay. What do you ask for?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: Excuse me, can we have the bill, please?
B: Yes, here you are. The total is thirty-five euros.
A: Can I pay by credit card?
B: Yes, of course. Here is your receipt.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to transactions at a restaurant cashier and a market stall, noting payment methods and amounts.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: I can ask for the bill at a restaurant and buy food items at a supermarket or market.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice speaking with your partner: I can ask for the bill at a restaurant and buy food items at a supermarket or market.
Writing Task:
Write 3-5 sentences in your notebook applying target phrases from today's lesson.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60m Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up & Goal; 10-25m Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Grammar Practice; 40-55m Speaking Pair Task; 55-60m Cool-down.
• 90m Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-30m 5-step Vocab Drills; 30-50m Grammar Workshop; 50-70m Roleplay; 70-85m Writing; 85-90m Wrap-up.
• 120m Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Vocab Lab; 40-70m Grammar Simulation; 70-100m Group Activity; 100-115m Writing Portfolio; 115-120m Reflection.
